longDescription: Understand the enforcement landscape of intellectual property rights. Understand various remedies in private civil actions. Analyse intellectual property rights violations and remedies under UK laws. Analyse Intellectual Property Rights Violations and Remedies Under US Laws. This course has been designed to explain intellectual property rights' complex and risky enforcement landscape. The course covers various remedies for victims, both in private civil and criminal actions. In addition to critical procedural elements, the course explores intellectual property rights violations and remedies under UK and U.S. laws.
